description: Conversion of garage to habitable room; Replace garage door with window in front elevation; First floor side extension; Single and two storey rear extension; Creation of basement level; External alterations (Demolition of Conservatory): Subdivision of Dwelling into Two Dwellings (1 x 2 beds & 1 x 3 beds); amenity space; parking; bin / cycle storage

superseding_details.unit_reference: One existing residential dwelling (Use Class C3) subject to planning permission ref. PL/3223/25.
superseding_details.component_description: The approved extensions, basement works and associated alterations under planning permission ref. PL/3223/25 are superseded by the revised proposal.

decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-bidi-font-weight:
bold">Prior to development above ground level, details of the sustainability
measures to be incorporated into the development shall be submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include
energy efficiency measures, renewable or low-carbon energy measures, and
measures to ensure that each dwelling achieves a maximum water consumption of
105 litres per person per day.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-bidi-font-weight:
bold">&nbsp;</span></p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
Swiss721BT-Roman;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold">The
approved measures shall be implemented prior to occupation of the development
and retained thereafter.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Prior to development above ground level, details of the proposed surface
water and foul water drainage arrangements shall be submitted to and approved
in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include separate
surface and foul water drainage arrangements, the proposed surface water
outfall, and appropriate sustainable drainage measures, including permeable
surfacing to new or altered hardstanding.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><br></p><p>



The approved measures shall
be implemented prior to first occupation and retained thereafter</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Prior to
commencement of development above ground level, a detailed landscaping and
biodiversity scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local
Planning Authority. The scheme shall include:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><br></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->·<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span><!--[endif]-->details of proposed planting, including species, sizes
and locations; <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->·<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span><!--[endif]-->hedge and shrub planting; <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->·<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span><!--[endif]-->provision of a suitable tree within the front garden
where practicable; and <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->·<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span><!--[endif]-->appropriate biodiversity enhancements including bird
and bat boxes and/or integrated swift bricks located on suitable north- or
east-facing elevations<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="">The landscaping
proposals shall have regard to the available substrate depth above the proposed
basement.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p>

















The approved landscaping shall be implemented prior to
first occupation or within the first planting season following completion of
the development, whichever is sooner. Any tree, hedge or shrub which dies, is
removed or becomes seriously damaged or diseased within five years of planting
shall be replaced with a suitable equivalent. The approved biodiversity
features shall be installed prior to first occupation and permanently retained
thereafter</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-bidi-font-weight:
bold">Prior to first occupation of the development, the two car parking spaces
shown on the approved plans shall be provided and made available for use. The
spaces shall thereafter be permanently retained and kept available for the
parking of vehicles associated with the respective dwelling.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB">Prior to first
occupation of the development, details of secure cycle parking within the rear
garden of each dwelling shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the
Local Planning Authority. The details shall provide for a minimum of two cycle
spaces for each dwelling, within a covered, enclosed and lockable store.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB">&nbsp;</span></p><p>



</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB">The approved
cycle parking shall be provided prior to first occupation of the respective
dwelling and thereafter retained and kept available for cycle parking.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Prior to first
occupation of Unit 18A, all windows within its southern flank elevation shall
be fitted with obscure glazing to a minimum privacy level equivalent to
Pilkington Level 3 and shall be fixed shut. The windows shall thereafter be
permanently retained as such.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:
EN-GB;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold">The development shall
be carried out in accordance with the flood risk mitigation measures contained
within the submitted Flood Risk Assessment prepared by RIDA Reports (Ref. 864
FRA-v1, July 2026), including the proposed basement waterproofing/tanking measures,
and shall thereafter be retained as such.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:
EN-GB;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold">The development hereby
permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the measures and
recommendations contained within the approved Fire Statement (Planning Fire
Safety Strategy, 18 Hazelwood Close, Harrow, HA2 6HD, dated July 2026) and
shall thereafter be maintained in accordance with those details.</span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-bidi-font-weight:
bold">The basement development hereby permitted shall be carried out in
accordance with the Construction Method Statement and Stability Design Document
prepared by RP Designs (Ref: 18 Hazelwood Close, Harrow, HA2 6HD, dated 12 July
2026).<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:
EN-GB;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold">The development hereby
permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the Basement Waterproofing
Plan (Ref: 18 Hazelwood Close, Harrow, HA2 6HD, Version 2.0 dated 17 July
2026). The approved measures shall be implemented in full and thereafter
retained.</span></p>
